content.name: Project Sakhi
content.subtitle: Empowering Women Through Confidence, Skills, Health & Independence
content.cardText: Project Sakhi is a holistic women empowerment initiative dedicated to strengthening confidence, self-reliance, health awareness, and economic independence among women from marginalized communities. Through skills, knowledge, and support, the project enables women to become active contributors and leaders in society.
content.mission: Project Sakhi works to empower women economically, socially, physically, and emotionally by providing opportunities, awareness, resources, and support systems that enable them to live with dignity and confidence.
content.whyItMatters: Many women face challenges such as financial dependence, limited access to opportunities, lack of health awareness, and social barriers. Project Sakhi helps overcome these challenges through a comprehensive empowerment approach.

services.title: Skill Development
services.desc: Training programs that help women acquire income-generating and livelihood skills.

services.title: Livelihood Support
services.desc: Opportunities for sustainable employment and self-employment initiatives.

services.title: Health & Hygiene Support
services.desc: Access to menstrual hygiene products, personal care resources, and health essentials.

services.title: Awareness Campaigns
services.desc: Sessions on health, sanitation, nutrition, rights awareness, safety, and financial literacy.
